name: Level Shaders Fix (Render Scale)
description: Experimental scene render scaling and pixelation correction for GD 2.2081.

render-percent.name: Scene render scale (%)
render-percent.description: 100 = native quality. Lower values soften the scene and may reduce GPU scene-rendering work when level shaders are active. Pixelation triggers take priority. Restart GD after changing.

smooth-upscale.name: Smooth upscale
smooth-upscale.description: Use texture filtering for the lower-resolution scene. Only affects render scales below 100%. Restart GD after changing.

fix-pixelation.name: Correct pixelation grid
fix-pixelation.description: Fit whole pixelation cells and align the snap grid. Level pixelation takes priority over scene render scaling. Restart GD after changing.
